dog.description_text:
My previous foster writes: Buttercup is such a sweet, precious angel. I was so surprised by how quickly he warmed up to me and how trusting he is. I feared he might be distrustful of strangers and initially hesitated to let others pet him, but his playful, friendly demeanor won over so many hearts on our walks. It quickly became clear that he is dying to be shown affection by everyone he meets. He is so intelligent and picked up on verbal commands quickly. He is perfectly potty trained. He is equally as playful and energetic as he is a couch potato. My favorite part of the weekend was when he would gently lay his head in my lap, asking so politely for a cuddle. Then, he would jump in my lap and curl up into the smallest little ball. I am eagerly awaiting the day that Buttercup gets adopted. He deserves his own home, bed, sofa, and basket of toys. He deserves a human to call his own. I just know he will make the perfect best friend for a very, very lucky person.

My BoroughBreak Buddy Writes: Meet Buttercup, a young, intelligent, energetic, and affectionate dog looking for his forever home at NYC Animal Care Centers (ID #263054).

We had the pleasure of taking Buttercup on an afternoon adventure in Central Park and discovered a wonderful dog full of curiosity, personality, and love.

From the moment we met him, Buttercup was bursting with excitement. He initially pulled and zigzagged on the leash as he explored, but noticeably relaxed in quieter surroundings and became much easier to guide. He's a smart boy who already knows sit, down, and paw, and is highly motivated by treats and affection. With continued positive-reinforcement training, he'll make a wonderful student!

A natural explorer, Buttercup loves sniffing trails and watching the world around him. He's comfortable with stairs and could make a fantastic hiking companion or even a running partner with the right training.

Perhaps his sweetest quality is how much he loves affection. He'd press his whole body against our legs for scratches and cuddles, happily roll over for belly rubs, and soak up every bit of attention.

What impressed us most was watching Buttercup transform from an exuberant explorer into a calmer, affectionate companion as the afternoon progressed. He's curious, responsive, eager to learn, and full of potential.

With patience, structure, and love, we believe he'll make an incredibly rewarding and loyal companion. We hope he finds a family who will embrace his adventurous spirit and give him the stability and affection he deserves!

Meet Buttercup!

Buttercup is a curious, energetic guy who loves checking out everything around him. He'll happily wander around sniffing, rub his shoulder against furniture and his people, and is always ready to come say hello. He can be a little nervous when it comes to handling, but with patience and some encouragement, this sweet boy has plenty of room to blossom!

My Ideal Home

Buttercup is looking for an adult family who can give him a little time to settle in and show him the ropes. He'll be happiest with people who enjoy keeping him busy with walks, food puzzles, long lasting chews, and fun reward based training sessions.

Good with Other Pets?

Buttercup hasn't had a chance to tell us what he thinks of living with another dog, but he definitely gets excited when he sees them! During playgroups, he has been very eager to play and has repeatedly tried to mount his canine friends, so he'll need controlled introductions and socialization rather than trips to the dog park.

Good with Kids?

Buttercup would do best with grown ups who can understand his boundaries and let him take new things at his own pace. Because he can be fearful and has shown some resource guarding, we are recommending an adult only home for him.

Things to Know

Buttercup has some mild leash pulling and can get pretty enthusiastic when greeting people, which means his jumping skills could use a little polishing. He can also get tense around toys when someone reaches for them, so his new family should use positive, reward based training and give him space around things he considers valuable. Give this Buttercup some patience, structure, and plenty of things to do, and he'll have every chance to really bloom!
dog.name: Buttercup
